caption:
Your AI has a "Custom Instructions" box and you're probably wasting it.

Most people type something like "I like concise answers" or "I'm a marketer" and call it a day.

Then wonder why the responses still feel… off.

Here's the actual problem: AI doesn't need your job title. It needs to know HOW you think.

For ChatGPT → Settings > Personalization > Custom Instructions
For Claude → Profile > Custom Instructions (or just paste it into any conversation)
For Gemini → Settings > Personalization

But what do you actually PUT there?

Not: "I work in finance and like bullet points."

Yes: "I think in systems. I need you to show me how things connect before giving me recommendations. Skip the reassurance. If my idea has a flaw, lead with the flaw."

See the difference?

One tells AI your job. One tells AI your brain.

The custom instructions box is only as useful as your self-awareness about how you process information — which, honestly, most of us have never been asked to think about.

That's exactly what BootFile does. It builds the instruction profile you'd never think to write yourself.
